meta.note: CALCULATED scores. Rank 1 is the rarest. Probabilities are shares of the 1,969 tokens. Not the project's or OpenSea's ranking.

methods.label: M1 information content, absence counted
methods.describe: sum over the 13 categories of -log2(share of tokens with that value, or without the category)

methods.label: M2 information content, present traits only
methods.describe: sum over the traits the token has of -log2(share of tokens with that value)

methods.label: M3 inverse frequency sum
methods.describe: sum over the traits the token has of 1 / share of tokens with that value

methods.label: M4 rarest single trait
methods.describe: share of tokens holding the token's rarest trait; smaller is rarer

methods.label: M5 information content, absence counted, plus trait count
methods.describe: M1 plus -log2(share of tokens that have the same number of traits); the number of traits is treated as one more trait

comparisonWithOpenSeaSample.note: Spearman correlation of the OpenSea rank with each method over the tokens in the sample
